subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw ship and maintain a separate Rust launcher binary as a supported core entry point in addition to the canonical CLI?
rationale: The patch creates a durable binary, build, packaging, support, and compatibility boundary; source review cannot determine whether that product surface belongs in core.

options.title: Keep the launcher external
options.body: Do not add a root Rust launcher to core; publish and maintain it independently if there is demand.

options.title: Sponsor a core launcher
options.body: Define its distribution, release ownership, supported platforms, upgrade behavior, and tests before accepting a reduced, repository-clean implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep the launcher external
recommendation.body: Do not add a root Rust launcher to core; publish and maintain it independently if there is demand.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available routing candidate for a core CLI and distribution-boundary decision.
